integrity_statement: Proof uses a cited nonequivariant theorem plus an explicit signed-word Lefschetz argument; finite checker output is corroboration, not proof of the all-length result. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant sphere classification is prior work. The result determines the integral reversal sign and only rational orbit-space homology; it does not determine the integral orbit-space groups or equivariant homotopy type. Equivalent unindexed work remains a risk.
title: Mod-eight reflection character of bidirected-path multipath complexes
